scope: Generation histories are not reused as production tally histories; generation and production seed assignments are disjoint. This is the requirement's defined seed-disjointness check.
generation_outputs: MGXS and weight-window proposal files; generation statepoints and source banks are not used to start production.

product_paths.evidence: Production request rejects both generation seeds; MGXS and window phases build their own models; production initializes a fresh selected-library C API run with the authored production seed.
SamplingPlan::validate rejects reserved seeds; analog_pass_sampling selects another nonzero, nonreserved seed. Cached window preparation retains only proposal artifacts, not histories.
MGXS and random-ray phases build separate models and emit proposal artifacts; no generation restart is supplied to production.

native_verification.build_scope: O0 feedback/control test build; not release or performance evidence
native_verification.applicability: Seed policy has not changed since that build; pending replay-loader changes are unrelated to seed selection.

limits: This does not establish mathematical PRNG-stream non-overlap or statistical independence beyond the stated seed policy.
